items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practice; ETR lists under OUT OR DOUBTFUL. Corroborated by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; history of missing time on hamstring.
items.implication: Major downgrade for HOU pass catchers and Stroud; stream TE/WR options.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU WRs and Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Zay Flowers listed DOUBTFUL (hamstring) for Week 2 vs NO; limited Friday practice after missing prior days. ETR OUT OR DOUBTFUL with Ja'Kobi Lane.
items.why: Hamstring that ended Week 1 early; second straight limited/missed practices initially.
items.implication: Expect inactive; BAL WR room thinned significantly.
items.opportunity: Targets to Mark Andrews, Rashod Bateman, others; hierarchy crumbs.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee) for Week 2 vs LAC after limited Friday return post-meniscus procedure; ETR lists OUT OR DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Knee procedure pre-Week 1; practiced Friday but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Prepare for absence; possible GTD but lean out.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated targets/routes as primary TE.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (ribs) for Week 2 vs LV after limited Friday practice; biggest injury on slate per Levitan. ETR Q list.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; returned limited Friday.
items.implication: GTD impacting Herbert and LAC projections heavily; 4pm ET game.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to Quentin Johnston and other LAC pass catchers.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) missed Friday practice; added to injury report ahead of MNF vs NYG. Donald plans to play.
items.why: Hip issue (possible related to prior psoas/groin).
items.implication: Monitor Saturday practice/final report for MNF availability; high concern.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, boost Davante Adams and other LAR WRs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs.
items.why: Ribs impact routes/contested catches; cascading projections.
items.implication: Herbert and LAC offense volatility; update immediately on status.
items.opportunity: Monitor for Johnston etc if out.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers with AJ Brown IR; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Returning at right time with nice matchups ahead.
items.why: Explosive need + schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc pre-bye); unclear vs Stevenson share.
items.implication: Potential flex/RB2 upside if 10+ touches materialize.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing for Week 2 at HOU; ETR notes expectation to play.
items.why: Back tightness; Burrow adamant he will play.
items.implication: Monitor but lean active; CIN offense intact if so.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN/cleared for Week 2 debut after ankle; ETR IN list. Patriots need playmakers with AJ Brown IR.
items.implication: Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson in favorable stretch.
items.opportunity: Role expansion possible as explosive playmaker; monitor snap/carry share.

items.text: Alvin Kamara IN for Week 2; ETR lists under IN. Squeeze on Etienne/Miller backfield.
items.implication: Further limits Etienne role in pass game/rushes.
items.opportunity: Kamara primary; reverse prior Etienne beneficiaries.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target share on routes (tied lead). IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; massive season potential if healthy.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
items.why: Elite usage under Kubiak; overreaction to injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG career with Wentz. CHI allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.implication: WR1 with high target share expected.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back further squeezes role. NO underdogs not rush-friendly.
